base4-82.name: Nidoran♀
base4-82.description: Although small, its venomous barbs make this Pokémon dangerous. The female has smaller horns.

attacks.name: Fury Swipes
attacks.effect: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.effect: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon named Nidoran M or Nidoran F and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward. (You can't use this attack if your Bench is full.)

base4-83.name: Nidoran♂
base4-83.description: Stiffens its ears to sense danger. The larger, more powerful of its horns secretes venom.

attacks.name: Horn Hazard
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

base4-84.name: Onix
base4-84.description: As it grows, the stone portions of its body harden to become similar to a diamond, though colored black.

attacks.name: Harden
attacks.effect: During opponent's next turn, whenever 30 or less damage is done to Onix (after applying Weakness and Resistance), prevent that damage. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.)

base4-85.name: Paras
base4-85.description: Burrows to suck tree roots. The mushrooms on its back grow by drawing nutrients from the bug host.

attacks.name: Spore
attacks.effect: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

base4-86.name: Pidgey
base4-86.description: A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.

attacks.name: Whirlwind
attacks.effect: If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, he or she chooses 1 of them and switches it with the Defending Pokémon. (Do the damage before switching the Pokémon.)

base4-87.name: Pikachu
base4-87.description: When several of these Pokémon gather, their electricity can cause lightning storms.

attacks.name: Thunder Jolt
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, Pikachu does 10 damage to itself.

base4-88.name: Poliwag
base4-88.description: Its newly grown legs prevent it from running. It appears to prefer swimming over trying to stand.

attacks.name: Water Gun
attacks.effect: Does 10 damage plus 10 damage for each Energy attached to Poliwag but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. Extra Energy after the end don't count.

base4-89.name: Rattata
base4-89.description: Bites anything when it attacks. Small and very quick, it is a common sight in many places.

base4-90.name: Rhyhorn
base4-90.description: Its massive bones are 1,000 times harder than human bones. It can easily knock a trailer flying.

attacks.name: Leer
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon can't attack Rhyhorn during your opponent's next turn. (Benching either Pokémon ends this effect.)

base4-91.name: Sandshrew
base4-91.description: Burrows deep underground in arid locations far from water. It only emerges to hunt for food.

attacks.name: Sand-attack
attacks.effect: If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing.

base4-92.name: Spearow
base4-92.description: Eats bugs in grassy areas. It has to flap its short wings at high speeds to stay airborne.

attacks.name: Mirror Move
attacks.effect: If Spearow was attacked last turn, do the final result of that attack on Spearow to the Defending Pokémon.

base4-93.name: Squirtle
base4-93.description: After birth, its back swells and hardens into a shell. It powerfully sprays foam from its mouth.

attacks.name: Bubble
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Withdraw
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Squirtle during your opponent's next turn. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.)

base4-94.name: Starmie
base4-94.description: Its central core glows with the seven colors of the rainbow. Some people value this core as a gem.

attacks.name: Recover
attacks.effect: Discard 1 Energy card to Starmie in order to use this attack. Remove all damage counters from Starmie.

attacks.name: Star Freeze
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

base4-95.name: Staryu
base4-95.description: An enigmatic Pokémon that can effortlessly regenerate any appendage it loses in battle.

base4-96.name: Tangela
base4-96.description: Its whole body is swathed with wide vines that are similar to seaweed. These vines shake as it walks.

attacks.name: Bind
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Poisonpowder
attacks.effect: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

base4-97.name: Venonat
base4-97.description: Lives in the shadows of tall trees where it eats insects. It is attracted by light at night.

attacks.name: Stun Spore
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Leech Life
attacks.effect: Remove a number of damage counters from Venonat equal to the damage done to the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

base4-98.name: Voltorb
base4-98.description: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a Poké Ball, it has zapped many people.

base4-99.name: Vulpix
base4-99.description: At the time of birth, it has just one tail. Its tail splits from the tip as it grows older.

attacks.name: Confuse Ray
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

base4-100.name: Weedle
base4-100.description: Often found in forests, eating leaves. It has a sharp, venomous stinger on its head.

attacks.name: Poison Sting
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

base4-101.name: Computer Search
base4-101.effect: Discard 2 of the other cards from your hand in order to search your deck for any card and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

base4-102.name: Impostor Professor Oak
base4-102.effect: Your opponent shuffles his or her hand into his or her deck, then draws 7 cards.

base4-103.name: Item Finder
base4-103.effect: Discard 2 of the other cards from your hand in order to put a Trainer card from your discard pile into your hand.

base4-104.name: Lass
base4-104.effect: You and your opponent show each other your hands, then shuffle all the Trainer cards from your hands into your decks.

base4-105.name: Pokémon Breeder
base4-105.effect: Put a Stage 2 Evolution card from your hand on the matching Basic Pokémon. You can only play this card when you would be allowed to evolve that Pokémon anyway.

base4-106.name: Pokémon Trader
base4-106.effect: Trade 1 of the Basic Pokémon or Evolution cards in your hand for 1 of the Basic Pokémon or Evolution cards from your deck. Show both cards to your opponent. Shuffle your deck afterward.

base4-107.name: Scoop Up
base4-107.effect: Choose 1 of your Pokémon in play and return its Basic Pokémon card to your hand. (Discard all cards attached to that card.)

base4-108.name: Super Energy Removal
base4-108.effect: Discard 1 Energy card attached to 1 of your own Pokémon in order to choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon and up to 2 Energy cards attached to it. Discard those Energy cards.

base4-109.name: Defender
base4-109.effect: Attach Defender to 1 of your Pokémon. At the end of your opponent's next turn, discard Defender. Damage done to that Pokémon by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

base4-110.name: Energy Retrieval
base4-110.effect: Trade 1 of the other cards in your hand for up to 2 basic Energy cards from your discard pile.

base4-111.name: Full Heal
base4-111.effect: Your Active Pokémon is no longer Asleep, Confused, Paralyzed, or Poisoned.

base4-112.name: Maintenance
base4-112.effect: Shuffle 2 of the other cards from your hand into your deck in order to draw a card.

base4-113.name: PlusPower
base4-113.effect: Attach PlusPower to your Active Pokémon. At the end of your turn, discard PlusPower. If this Pokémon's attack does damage to the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance), the attack does 10 more damage to the Defending Pokémon.

base4-114.name: Pokémon Center
base4-114.effect: Remove all damage counters from all of your own Pokémon with damage counters on them, then discard all Energy cards attached to those Pokémon.

base4-115.name: Pokédex
base4-115.effect: Look at up to 5 cards from the top of your deck and rearrange them as you like.

base4-116.name: Professor Oak
base4-116.effect: Discard your hand, then draw 7 cards.

base4-117.name: Super Potion
base4-117.effect: Discard 1 Energy card attached to 1 of your own Pokémon in order to remove up to 4 damage counters from that Pokémon.

base4-119.name: Energy Removal
base4-119.effect: Choose 1 Energy card attached to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon and discard it.

base4-120.name: Gust of Wind
base4-120.effect: Choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon and switch it with his or her Active Pokémon.

base4-121.name: Poké Ball
base4-121.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, you may search your deck for any Basic Pokémon or Evolution card. Show that card to your opponent, then put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

base4-122.name: Potion
base4-122.effect: Remove up to 2 damage counters from 1 of your Pokémon.

base4-123.name: Switch
base4-123.effect: Switch 1 of your Benched Pokémon with your Active Pokémon.

base4-124.name: Double Colorless Energy
base4-124.effect: Provides {C}{C} energy. Doesn't count as a basic Energy card.
